message:
4 string literals reach the DOM from an expression: libs/components/widget/src/blank.ts: host `[value]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/blank.ts: host `[defaultValue]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/blank.ts: host `[attr.value]` → "Delete the row" libs/components/widget/src/marker.ts: host `[attr.srcdoc]` → "

Delete the row

"
description: Sentences a `host` block binds to what an element of one tag draws: the `value` of a field, bound as a property, as its `defaultValue` and as an attribute, on `PctBlank`, a component on `input[pctBlank]`, and an `<iframe>`'s `srcdoc` as an attribute on `PctMarker`, whose selector `[pctMarker]` names no element, where `ngc` checks an `attr.` binding against nothing (measured through ngc in partial mode: each compiles; JIT and a render in jsdom: each draws on the element named). The block was read by an attribute's name alone, and `value` and `srcdoc` speak on one element each; so all four passed.
